packet_identity: Coordinator-supplied opaque packet digest; its construction was not provided and was not independently reconstructed. Frozen revision was supplied as Git81b680f; no Git access used.
tools: functions.exec / exec_command: find, cat, wc, nl, mkdir, .venv/bin/python
functions.exec / apply_patch: new run artifacts only
Python standard library: ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, platform, re

whole_module_inspection.method: Read all numbered source text without truncation, plus complete-module AST parsing and target binding audit. Manually checked class bodies, enclosing-scope expressions, and module control-flow bindings. Functions and methods are deferred scopes; their bodies are excluded from module binding judgments.
whole_module_inspection.helper_limitations: inspect_packet.py is a packet-specific supporting audit, not a general Python binding oracle. Manual full-module inspection covers constructs absent from its specialized visitor, including match and comprehension binding details.

signature_extraction: inspect_packet.py derives signatures exclusively from actual FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef AST nodes: aligned positional defaults; ordered positional-only, positional-or-keyword, variadic positional, keyword-only and variadic keyword parameters; annotations, return, ordered decorators and async status. Missing fields are null; literal None is its AST dump. Source-derived facts were saved before predicate comparisons. write_review.py then compares the preserved actual_signature with expected_signature and asserts consistency with independently chosen judgments.
sequence_note: An initial case-metadata display omitted predicate but retained the human-readable text, which exposed expected-signature text before extraction. No comparison was made then. Actual signature facts were subsequently derived from source AST without consuming predicate or text; the complete predicates were read and compared only after independent_facts.json was saved.

integrity.cases_integrity: Computed raw cases.json SHA256 and checked it remained unchanged during review; no separately supplied raw cases digest was available.
integrity.sources: All four raw source SHA256 values matched every cases.json reference; UTF-8 decoding and parsing succeeded.

access_limitations: Used only the assigned public packet and newly authored output artifacts; read no other repository material, other packets or reviews, private maps or keys, CAMI/generator/reference implementation, Git or policy results.
No network calls, source imports, source execution, or subagents.
No installed tokenizer was used; primary JSON is kept concise but no measured o200k_base token count is claimed.
